mutants.description: The capture pipeline loses the final speech region, which carries the 'forty two' answer; the missing region is real omitted speech, not silence.
The ASR hypothesis drops the negator 'never'; finding the remaining governed words in the output text proves nothing about the negation.
The authored output restarts the resumed list at 1 instead of continuing at 5, destroying the list continuation the user intended.
The stitcher declares a false chunk overlap and deletes an interior span containing 'parakeet' and 'benchmark'; tail presence cannot compensate.
The refinement stage truncates the authored output, losing the 'standup meeting' context the authored intent contract requires.
Delivery inserts a duplicated seven-token segment; the delivered text is not the authored revision even though every critical token is present.
The delivered text reflects a stale thread state: the superseded '4 stop there' revision is delivered after the list continued to 7.
